paper: AlphaLogics: A Market Logic-Driven Multi-Agent System for Scalable and Interpretable Alpha Factor Generation
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of AlphaLogics' explicit market-logic library, constrained factor DSL, validation-feedback inner loop, five-round persistent outer refinement, and final factor-pool scorer; not the unreleased LLM traces, generated author factor pool, LightGBM model, or daily Qlib strategy.

paper_source.bounded_release_search_checked_2026_09_0: Exact-title and arXiv-ID searches still identify the paper and unaffiliated component implementations, but no author-attributable code, logic library, generated factor pool, model, or result arrays.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Historical technical factor libraries are reverse-mapped from formula structure to financial semantics to an explicit market-logic library.

Each human-readable logic is canonicalized, compiled into executable variable/operator/sign constraints, and used to generate factors that receive validation-only backtest feedback with early stopping.
Logic-level evidence is aggregated across generated factors, new or refined logics persist in the library, and the best logic is retained across five outer rounds.
The native system uses OHLCV inputs, a 59-operation DSL, strict train/validation/test separation, generated factors plus four base factors in LightGBM, and a Top-50/drop-5 portfolio.

compiled_factor_dsl.cross_sectional_normalization: monthly percentile rank mapped to minus one through one
compiled_factor_dsl.pair_mean: arithmetic mean of two signed normalized primitives
compiled_factor_dsl.pair_product: product of two signed normalized primitives followed by cross-sectional reranking
compiled_factor_dsl.triple_mean: arithmetic mean of three signed normalized primitives
compiled_factor_dsl.positive_gate: one signed primitive multiplied by the indicator that a second signed primitive is positive, followed by cross-sectional reranking
compiled_factor_dsl.direction_rule: orient each candidate by the sign of validation mean RankIC, using validation data only

logic_evolution_policy.validation_objective: positive mean monthly RankIC divided by monthly RankIC standard deviation
logic_evolution_policy.final_model: ridge linear cross-sectional return scorer fitted once on calibration train plus validation
logic_evolution_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the frozen six-factor score enters value-weighted long-short deciles and all six common cost/missing-return paths
